'''Straden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Republic Army]] before joining the radicalized [[Order of Revan]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Straden was among the Revanite commanders who led the Revanite forces in defense of the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] during the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|battle]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] on the grounds of the [[Imperial Guard Academy]] by forces from the Imperial-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] coalition.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Straden appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is one four named enemies that must be defeated by players in the mission "The Enemy Within". Though her armor makes it impossible to identify her gender or [[Species/Legends|species]] in-game, her NPC identifies her as female and Human.<ref name="TOR" />
